core_principles: Stark monochrome base with International Klein Blue for functional highlighting
Use crisp 1px borders to define geometry
design_philosophy.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look) mixed with Glassmorphism for sticky navigation.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-tight
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-black/5

hero.layout: split-screen with heavy typography on left, abstract 3D visual on right. Max overlay opacity bg-white/30 if text overlap is required.
hero.cta: Solid background brand primary button, text-inverse.

cards.style: bg-white border border-border/40 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300

pricing.featured_card: Tracing Beam border effect, scale-105 on desktop

auth.layout: Split screen. Form on left, immersive full-height branded image with testimonial overlay on right.
auth.inputs: Shadcn defaults stripped down to crisp borders, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 for cards, explicit hover text colors.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Staggered fade-up (Framer Motion) for bento grid items.

hero_bg.description: Abstract white geometric shapes with a deep blue sphere

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pricing-pro-cta').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette. No neon green or purple unless explicitly required.
Use Outfit for Headings and IBM Plex Sans for Body. Import them via Google Fonts.
Build the bento grids using raw Tailwind HTML, not standard Shadcn cards for complex layouts.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all functional elements.
Include a marquee in the hero/feature section using the provided sponsor logo images, styled in greyscale using CSS filters.
Design 5 distinct pages: Home, About Us, Pricing, Signup, Login.
In the Signup page, explicitly include role selection (Candidate vs Business) using a visually prominent toggle or radio group.
Use standard React .js or .jsx file formats for implementation, not .tsx files.
